---
name: vibeschool-contract-integrity
description: Protect current canonical TypeScript, API, RPC, database, event and curriculum contracts from remembered or invented shapes.
---
# Contract Integrity
Resolve the canonical definition before constructing payloads, fixtures, mocks, SQL, RPC calls, generated types or adapters. Verify producers and consumers together. Reject stale remembered shapes, silent coercions and duplicated contract definitions. Contract migrations must define compatibility, data/backfill implications and affected tests. When current code and production disagree, treat it as a contradiction requiring reconciliation rather than choosing whichever is convenient.
